name: Enju
source:
A person of the past who passed away in 1986 at 31. 
Enju was the adoptive parent and mentor of Shuuzou, an orphaned boy. As a skilled sorcerer (cursed technique user), she taught Shuuzou the ways of jujutsu. Her life was tragically cut short when she died in a particular incident.

"But..... you see, we're cut from the same cloth, you and I. 'Cause at the end of the day, Shuuzou's all I've got."
